title: Live grouped interruption, exact continuation and terminal cancellation
question: Can a live grouped run retain its settled member, recover the interrupted task, and restore the resident service on both resumable and terminal cancellation?
method: Interrupt the active second CUDA member after the first mapping has settled. Resume after the original claim lease expires. Exercise a separate terminal cancellation and a controlled lost-child transport.
commands: uv run ci run resume 362 --project nce-grinstead-snell-full-book --json

outputs.role: Exact interrupted attempt, resumed pins, typed MCP packet and terminal result
Bounded managed interruption and cancellation driver

conclusion: Run 362 retained page 506, resumed page 151 under the original inference task in attempt 2 and sealed cut 479. The first interrupted receipt remained intact. Run 375 cancelled its active task and retained its two reused task records without a final cut. Both restored the resident Nemotron service. The controlled transport loss reopened only the child.
